content.Title: 2024 Perioperative Cardiovascular Management for Noncardiac Surgery Guideline

Sections.Title: 6.3.1 Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
Sections.Summary: Discusses perioperative considerations for patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy undergoing non-cardiac surgery.

Sections.Title: 6.3.2 Pulmonary Hypertension
Sections.Summary: Covers perioperative considerations and outcomes for patients with pulmonary hypertension undergoing non-cardiac surgery.

Sections.Title: 6.3.3 Adult Congenital Heart Disease
Sections.Summary: Explores the perioperative risks and considerations for adults with congenital heart disease undergoing non-cardiac surgery.

Sections.Title: 6.3.4 Left Ventricular Assist Devices
Sections.Summary: Focuses on the perioperative management and outcomes for patients with left ventricular assist devices.
